The '''Croke Reach''' was an [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that contained the [[Explume Minor system/Legends|Explume Minor system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The latter was the site of [[Explume Minor]], an astronomical object [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by members of the [[Croke]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

During a [[Croke civil war|civil war]], a faction of the Croke introduced the invasive [[Lugubraa]] species in the Croke Reach to fight as [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] for them. Over the following 300 [[Standard year/Legends|years]], however, the Lugubraa began to overrun Croke settlements, including Explume Minor, causing the Croke to fight for their survival. They eventually commissioned the [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]] of<ref name="TUR" /> the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to create a [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetically engineered]] [[Blind berserker|variant]] of the Lugubraa. The purpose behind the creation of the Lugubraa variant was to help fight the Lugubraa in the Croke Reach, but, over [[Time/Legends|time]], the engineered members of that species proved to be a threat to the Croke, as well.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Croke Reach was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
